description: Official Python SDK for the Zippendo shipping API: book shipments, print labels and track parcels with PostNord, GLS, DAO, Bring, DHL, DPD, UPS and more.
rules: Authenticate with an API token created in the Zippendo dashboard under Settings → API tokens. It is a Bearer token prefixed with zipp_; load it from configuration or an environment variable such as ZIPPENDO_API_TOKEN, never hard-code it.
The base URL defaults to https://api.zippendo.com; set it only to reach another environment.
Every call takes the organization ID explicitly. One API token can be granted access to several organizations, and that argument selects which one the request acts on.
The API is split into one client class per resource (shipments, orders, carriers, addresses, rules, webhooks, tokens and more); there is no single client object that covers everything.
To act inside one brand, set the X-Zippendo-Brand header (the brand's ID or slug) as a default header on the client; it is not a method parameter. Without it a request covers the whole organization.
List operations are paginated with page (1-based) and limit, and the response carries the total and the page count; fetch every page instead of assuming the first holds all rows.
Error responses carry the JSON body { code, error, message }. Branch on the machine-readable code, such as SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND, never on the message text.
Product concepts such as shipping rules, carrier products and service points are explained in the Zippendo documentation at https://www.zippendo.com/docs.
